The name Bikas carries the meaning “Enlightenment, Progress” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bikas usually hope their child will grow to embody enlightenment, progress and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Bikas Devi died on 16 October 1988.
